hotOnX.text: unkernel.dev runs a full Linux kernel and distro in a browser tab, coding agents and even Chrome inside Chrome.
hotOnX.note: A browser that can host agents changes where builders run code.

hotOnX.text: Gavin Baker: a tool that turns hours of Claude Code work into seconds feels like another ChatGPT moment.
hotOnX.note: Investors framing agent speedups as a platform moment draws wide attention.

hotOnX.text: Google's 'neon' is the hottest frontier model in the world; a completely revitalized GDM.
hotOnX.note: Builders are tracking whether Google now leads the frontier.

hotOnX.text: With agents, it's almost always better to build a new idea right away than to backlog it.
hotOnX.note: Agents are changing how teams prioritize work.

hotOnX.text: Balaji Srinivasan: a 'special founder zone' where builders move at the speed of physics, not permits.
hotOnX.note: Speed of regulation is becoming a competitive question for builders.
